scope: Independent read-only source and fixture review for CPU-controller adoption. No remote runtime or accuracy attestation.
validation: 18/18 focused capacity-scheduler tests pass. The WAITING_FOR_EVAL_CAPACITY path requires the existing native training wrapper to be COMPLETE/exit 0, then routes only future evaluation through the measured capacity gate.
behavior: GPU free memory must be at least6144MiB and host MemAvailable at least16GiB. The scheduler removes only the stale compute-process-count gate. Rehome verifies the old controller, original plan, active task and ready identity, then signals only the old CPU controller.
runtime_context: Existing B640 child training wrapper is terminal COMPLETE/exit0; adoption is CPU-controller-only. Original B640 plan, trainer, evaluator and scorer remain byte-identical.
